skill_name: Describe the main features of a tropical monsoon climate.
workflow: A tropical monsoon climate is characterized by a hot and humid summer season and a dry winter season. The main features of the tropical monsoon climate include abundant precipitation during the summer months, strong seasonal shifts of both temperature and precipitation, and largely temporal climates.
